faq.title: Answers to Technical & Operational Inquiries
faq.subtitle: Detailed explanations of platform mechanics, hardware interfaces, security, and governance
faq.q1: How does the Living Spatial Digital Twin track workers inside hospital wings?
faq.a1: MediInfra integrates Zebra AN440 dual-polarity circular antennas at all structural ingress portals, stairwells, and hoarding chokepoints. When a worker wearing an unforgeable EPC Gen2 UHF RFID hard-hat tag passes through a portal, the FXR90 reader timestamps the event and sends MQTT telemetry over a local 10 Gbps Cat6A backbone. The digital twin interpolates worker positions between verified portal nodes using deterministic architectural graph waypoints.
faq.q2: How are perimeter RFID turnstiles synchronized across the site?
faq.a2: Each turnstile lane is equipped with an edge gateway operating a store-and-forward SQLite cache. Turnstiles validate permissions locally in under 12ms even if the central server is temporarily unreachable. When network continuity is active, events sync bi-directionally over secure WebSockets with sub-50ms latency.
faq.q3: Can the platform operate completely offline during site network disruptions?
faq.a3: Yes. MediInfra is engineered with local autonomous survival modes. Edge gateways at Gates 01 through 04 maintain local worker credential caches, battery-backed industrial UPS power for up to 4.8 hours, and local flash storage that buffers up to 2,000,000 access events before synchronization.
faq.q4: How does Emergency Evacuation Muster reconcile headcounts during an incident?
faq.a4: Upon manual or automated fire alarm trip, all turnstile tripods drop into free-spin evacuation mode. Turnstile antennas switch to rapid burst egress reading. Workers scanning out at muster points (M1 through M4) are instantly checked off the active on-site register, leaving an exact, real-time triage list of unaccounted personnel categorized by trade, last known zone, and foreman contact.
faq.q5: How is Edge AI Safety Vision processed without violating privacy regulations?
faq.a5: Computer vision processing is executed entirely on-premise at the edge using NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin micro-servers. Video streams are analyzed frame-by-frame in volatile memory to detect PPE compliance. No facial recognition or raw video is stored or transmitted off-site, ensuring full compliance with Qatar Ministry of Public Health patient-area privacy laws.
faq.q6: Can audit reports and statutory filings be exported in official government formats?
faq.a6: Yes. MediInfra generates pre-formatted Ashghal Form LR-01 Daily Labor Returns, HSE Incident Registers, and Permit-to-Work Compliance packs. Every exported PDF includes an immutable SHA-256 cryptographic chain-of-custody hash verified against site turnstile ledger logs.
faq.q7: How does the Arabic localization and Right-to-Left (RTL) engine work?
faq.a7: The application features an instant, zero-reload bilingual engine using react-i18next and custom CSS logical properties. When toggling to Arabic, the layout shifts to native RTL, the sidebar mirrors to the right, fonts switch to Cairo and IBM Plex Sans Arabic, while technical codes, percentages, and latencies remain in standardized Latin numerals.
faq.q8: Is MediInfra deployed in the cloud, on-premise, or as a hybrid architecture?
faq.a8: MediInfra supports flexible deployment models. The standard hospital tier utilizes on-premise edge servers for physical gate control and AI inference, paired with a hybrid cloud synchronization layer hosted within Qatar sovereign cloud datacenters (Microsoft Azure Qatar / Google Cloud Doha) for executive dashboards.

faq.sectionSubtitle: Everything enterprise stakeholders need to know about implementing MediInfra.
faq.q1: How quickly can MediInfra be deployed on an active hospital job site?
faq.a1: A standard 4-gate turnstile deployment with Zebra FXR90 RFID portals, edge processing controllers, and 3D BIM ingestion takes 3 to 5 business days. Cloud connectivity is established via on-site private 5G or secure optical fiber.
faq.q2: Is all worker and site telemetry compliant with Qatar data sovereignty laws?
faq.a2: Yes. MediInfra is 100% compliant with State of Qatar Law No. 13 of 2016 (Personal Data Protection) and Qatar Cloud Policy Framework. Edge AI video streams are processed on-premise without raw video ever leaving the site.
faq.q3: Can MediInfra integrate with existing hospital building management systems (BMS)?
faq.a3: Absolutely. MediInfra natively supports BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP, OPC UA, and REST/MQTT APIs, allowing direct telemetry handoff to Siemens Desigo CC, Honeywell Forge, and Johnson Controls Metasys.
faq.q4: How does the emergency evacuation muster triage work during fire drills?
faq.a4: Upon alarm activation, muster readers at designated assembly zones automatically tally personnel badges. Missing workers are highlighted with their last known BIM floorplan coordinate and foreman contact for immediate first-responder dispatch.
faq.q5: Does the platform support contractor payroll and statutory labor verification?
faq.a5: Yes. MediInfra automatically produces Ashghal Form LR-01 and statutory labor verification dossiers with cryptographic SHA-256 seals, eliminating phantom labor and timesheet disputes.
